description: Displays a horizontal carousel of products with images, prices, discounts, and add-to-cart buttons. Supports filtering by item group, brand, promotions only, and various sorting options. Includes navigation arrows and responsive design.
parameters: [{"name": "carousel_title", "type": "string", "default": "", "description": "Title displayed above the carousel"}, {"name": "carousel_item_group", "type": "string", "default": "", "description": "Filter by Item Group name"}, {"name": "carousel_brand", "type": "string", "default": "", "description": "Filter by Brand name"}, {"name": "carousel_limit", "type": "integer", "default": "8", "description": "Maximum number of products to show"}, {"name": "carousel_sort_by", "type": "string", "default": "creation", "description": "Sort field: creation, modified, item_name, price"}, {"name": "carousel_sort_order", "type": "string", "default": "desc", "description": "Sort order: asc or desc"}, {"name": "show_discounted_only", "type": "boolean", "default": "false", "description": "Only show products with active discounts"}, {"name": "hide_without_image", "type": "boolean", "default": "false", "description": "Hide products without images"}, {"name": "view_more_link", "type": "string", "default": "", "description": "URL for View More button"}, {"name": "view_more_text", "type": "string", "default": "View More", "description": "Text for View More button"}]

description: Displays a horizontal carousel of brand logos with links to filtered product pages. Supports sorting by name, product count, or random. Each brand links to its filtered product listing.
parameters: [{"name": "carousel_title", "type": "string", "default": "", "description": "Title displayed above the carousel"}, {"name": "carousel_limit", "type": "integer", "default": "20", "description": "Maximum number of brands to show"}, {"name": "carousel_sort_by", "type": "string", "default": "brand_name", "description": "Sort by: brand_name, product_count, random"}, {"name": "hide_without_image", "type": "boolean", "default": "false", "description": "Hide brands without logo images"}, {"name": "show_product_count", "type": "boolean", "default": "false", "description": "Show number of products per brand"}]

description: Displays a breadcrumb navigation trail showing the current page hierarchy. Automatically generates based on page context or can be manually configured.
parameters: [{"name": "breadcrumbs", "type": "array", "default": "[]", "description": "List of {label, url} objects for manual breadcrumbs"}]

Displays published Blog Posts in a responsive grid or list layout. Supports filtering by category, sorting, and custom limits. Shows a styled placeholder when no articles exist. Each card includes cover image, category badge, title, intro, and publication date.
parameters: [{"name": "blog_title", "type": "string", "default": "", "description": "Section title displayed above the listing"}, {"name": "blog_category", "type": "string", "default": "", "description": "Filter by Blog Category name"}, {"name": "blog_limit", "type": "integer", "default": "6", "description": "Maximum number of posts to display"}, {"name": "blog_sort_by", "type": "string", "default": "published_on", "description": "Sort field: published_on, creation, title"}, {"name": "blog_layout", "type": "string", "default": "grid", "description": "Layout mode: grid or list"}, {"name": "view_more_link", "type": "string", "default": "", "description": "URL for View More button"}, {"name": "view_more_text", "type": "string", "default": "View All Articles", "description": "Text for View More button"}]
